title: Brain Plastic Rose To 4,900 Micrograms Per Gram
hook: Human brain plastic reached 4,900 micrograms per gram.
closing: Plastic exposure is no longer only environmental; researchers are measuring it inside the body.
question: Should plastic exposure be tracked?

segments.say: Brain tissue reached 4,900 micrograms of plastic per gram. The measured concentration rose sharply in eight years.
Microplastics appeared in 100 percent of tested placentas. Exposure is crossing into tissue that supports new life.
Plaque containing microplastics carried a 4.5 risk index. The association makes internal exposure a health question.
